name: usa-bank-working-day
description: calculate U.S.A government bank working day without outer dependencies

scripts.test:tz: cross-env TZ=UTC bun test -t "date semantics contract" && cross-env TZ=America/New_York bun test -t "date semantics contract"
scripts.check:package: npm run smoke:cjs && npm run smoke:esm && rm -f ./*.tgz && npm pack && npx @arethetypeswrong/cli ./*.tgz && npx publint
scripts.smoke:cjs: set -eu; rm -f ./*.tgz; TGZ=$(npm pack --silent); TGZ_PATH="$PWD/$TGZ"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); npm --silent --prefix "$TMP" init -y >/dev/null; npm --silent --prefix "$TMP" install "$TGZ_PATH" >/dev/null; (cd "$TMP" && node -e 'const path=require("node:path"); const resolved=require.resolve("usa-bank-working-day"); if(!resolved.endsWith(path.join("dist","cjs","index.cjs"))) throw new Error("Expected CJS entry, got: "+resolved); const toolkit=require("usa-bank-working-day"); if(!toolkit||typeof toolkit.isBankHoliday!=="function") throw new Error("Unexpected default export shape"); if(typeof toolkit.UsaBankWorkingDayToolKit!=="function"||typeof toolkit.createUsaBankWorkingDayToolKit!=="function") throw new Error("Missing CJS named exports"); console.log("CJS smoke OK:", resolved);'); rm -rf "$TMP";
scripts.smoke:esm: set -eu; rm -f ./*.tgz; TGZ=$(npm pack --silent); TGZ_PATH="$PWD/$TGZ"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); npm --silent --prefix "$TMP" init -y >/dev/null; npm --silent --prefix "$TMP" install "$TGZ_PATH" >/dev/null; (cd "$TMP" && node --input-type=module -e 'const resolved=import.meta.resolve("usa-bank-working-day"); if(!resolved.endsWith("/dist/esm/index.mjs")) throw new Error("Expected ESM entry, got: "+resolved); const m=await import("usa-bank-working-day"); const toolkit=m.default; if(!toolkit||typeof toolkit.isBankHoliday!=="function") throw new Error("Unexpected default export shape"); if(typeof m.UsaBankWorkingDayToolKit!=="function"||typeof m.createUsaBankWorkingDayToolKit!=="function") throw new Error("Missing ESM named exports"); console.log("ESM smoke OK:", resolved);'); rm -rf "$TMP";
